game.label: Your own copy of Resistance 3, US disc BCUS98176, version 1.00: its decrypted disc image (.iso), or its folder with PS3_GAME and PS3_DISC.SFB in it (as RPCS3 uses). Other regions don't work yet.

prepare.label: Building the game for your Mac from your disc (the first time takes 15 to 45 minutes and about 8 GB; macOS may ask once to install Apple's Command Line Tools)

settings.label: Window
settings.help: Full screen is macOS's own (its own Space). Borderless covers the screen without changing Spaces.

settings.label: Window size
settings.help: The size the game's window opens at.

settings.label: V-Sync
settings.help: On waits for the screen's refresh: no tearing.

settings.label: Resolution
settings.help: What the game draws at. 720p is the PS3's own; higher is sharper and needs a faster Mac. Experimental.

settings.label: Upscaling
settings.help: How the picture is fitted to the window. MetalFX is Apple's upscaler (macOS 13 or newer).

settings.label: Anti-aliasing
settings.help: Smooths jagged edges. SMAA is sharper than FXAA and costs a little more.

settings.label: Texture filtering
settings.help: Keeps floors and roads sharp at shallow angles.

settings.label: Show FPS
settings.help: The frame rate and frame times in the window's title.

settings.label: Keep the Mac awake
settings.help: The Mac doesn't go to sleep while the game runs.

actions.label: Saves
actions.help: Your Resistance 3 save slots, as the game writes them (BCUS98176_SAVE_...).

actions.label: Logs
actions.help: last.log (the last session), install.log (the last setup) and logs/ with the sessions before.

actions.label: Shader cache
actions.help: Shaders the game has built, so later sessions don't stutter. Clearing only helps if the picture looks wrong after an update.

exit_codes.40: Your copy isn't the one this port reads: it needs your own Resistance 3 US disc, BCUS98176 version 1.00, as a disc image (.iso) or a folder with PS3_GAME and PS3_DISC.SFB. Pick it again on the game's page.
exit_codes.41: Your Mac needs something first: Apple's Command Line Tools (their installer opened: finish it), or RPCS3 when it says so. Then set the game up again.
exit_codes.42: Couldn't download what the build needs (the port's sources, the toolkit or its Python packages). Check the internet connection and set the game up again.
exit_codes.43: Building the game failed. Check there are about 8 GB free, then set it up again: it continues where it stopped. install.log in the logs folder says why.
exit_codes.44: Resistance 3 is already running, or another setup of it is. Close it or wait for it, then try again.
exit_codes.45: The game isn't built yet. Set it up again on the game's page (the first time takes 15 to 45 minutes).
exit_codes.46: The Resistance 3 launcher couldn't start it. Open the launcher itself to see why.
